result.title: Testing Quantized KV-Cache Maintenance: Encoding Layout and Historical Restoration
result.summary: Repeating rows then selecting originals retains layout-dependent drift despite equal encoding counts. We measure when existing checks fail to establish preservation contracts in fixed quantized KV-cache implementations. In four-bit HQQ axis zero at sixteen cycles, median paired relative-L2 increases over same-shape re-encoding are 7.22 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B and 11.59 for SmolLM3-3B. Matched encoded states cover sixteen shared questions per model at one and sixteen cycles. Axis one matches the shape-preserving control; lazy reorders preserve the initial state. On one known input, fixed update counts retain the difference; preserving group members removes it. Our prefix-view extension passes current-prefix checks yet changes history and next logits in six model/codec settings at residual capacities four and 128. Public lookup reaches this boundary, including one of four precommitted project-new GPU inputs; fixed query swaps isolate a conditional old-history effect. Checkpoint/dense rollback is exact. An explicit delayed lookup client admits a supported 129-token path excluded by native AR on one known context. Failed task-harm expansion precludes population failure-rate or general answer-degradation claims. Native MLX-LM fixtures expose stale caller caches; synchronization restores the tested in-place contract with native computations preserved. In rejection tests, stale callers change logits but not greedy tokens.

AI.brief_summary: 论文检验固定四位量化 KV-cache 实现的「保持契约」：重复写入再取原始行、惰性重排与前缀视图扩展是否改变缓存内容；用配对相对 L2 与同形重编码对照量化布局相关漂移，并给出同步、检查点回滚等边界结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究兴趣涉及缓存与位置对 latent 相似度的影响、内部状态是否保真保留历史证据；其配对对照与不变式检验协议可能可供核查 LVR 缓存状态保留，但需较多迁移工作。
